title: Cosmologically-Coupled Black Holes and Dark Energy: Alleviating the Hubble Tension

contributions.purpose: 提出宇宙学耦合黑洞(CCBH)作为暗能量引擎的物理模型
contributions.mechanism: 黑洞质量随尺度因子增长(用quasi-local Misner-Sharp质量而非ADM质量),经修正Friedmann方程把物质转化为暗能量,并将其产率与宇宙恒星形成率密度SFRD挂钩
contributions.evaluation: 定性:声称能自然解释z~0.7的加速起点,无需ad-hoc参数;未报告任何拟合数字
contributions.source_quote: The CCBH model proposes that the masses of black holes are not strictly conserved, but instead increase with the expansion of the universe... effectively transfers energy from the matter sector to the dark energy sector.

contributions.purpose: 论证CCBH模型缓解哈勃张力
contributions.mechanism: 用DESI(实际用DR1代DR2)+CMB(Planck/ACT/SPT)数据做贝叶斯MCMC约束,比较ΛCDM并检视H0后验
contributions.evaluation: 声称'significant reduction'使H0更接近本地测量同时兼容CMB——但正文未给任何H0数值、χ²、AIC/BIC或后验区间,纯叙述
contributions.source_quote: Our findings indicate a significant reduction in the tension, bringing the model's predicted value of H0 into closer agreement with local measurements while maintaining consistency with CMB data.

contributions.purpose: 验证模型与早期宇宙物理及中微子约束相容
contributions.mechanism: 检查BBN氘/氦-4丰度一致性,并评估CCBH对中微子质量约束的影响
contributions.evaluation: 定性:声称BBN预测与观测一致、对中微子质量估计有可辨影响,无量化结果
contributions.source_quote: our analysis shows that the predicted deuterium and helium-4 abundances remain consistent with observed values when the CCBH contribution to the expansion rate is properly accounted for.

self_declared_provenance.quote: The idea builds upon theoretical frameworks that allow for black hole mass to increase with the expansion of the universe, thereby violating strong energy conditions within the black hole interior, which leads to contribution to dark energy.

notes: 数据可信度重大红旗:摘要称'perform a rigorous analysis'并列出DESI+CMB+MCMC+AIC/BIC完整方法,但Results全节零数字——无H0值、无拟合优度、无图表、无后验,所有'success/reduction/agreement'均为空口叙述,checklist却答复现性/实验细节均[Yes]。方法自曝:4.1节承认DR2数据不可用,改用DR1'作为代理'。参数命名不一致:3.3节耦合常数称κ,结论却称α。机器生成痕迹突出:正文塞入大量与宇宙学完全无关的乱引用,如'it may address the limitations of animal models in medical studies [69]'、'as highlighted by recent research in generative AI [74-77]'、'it is not possible to use traditional methods to establish efficacy in diagnostic testing [70-73] in this area of physics'——疑似引用注入/幻觉。AI披露:实验设计/分析/写作均[D]。无真正负结果(6.3弱点节仅泛泛谈观测困难)。
